summary: Virax Biolabs Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) held on August 21, 2026, after an initial meeting on August 14 lacked quorum (only 6.33% of shares present). At the adjourned meeting, quorum was lowered per Articles. Shareholders approved Proposal 1, increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 into 2,000,000 shares to US$12.5 million into 500,000,000 shares (for: 61,471; against: 54,414; abstain: 4,342). Proposal 2, adopting amended articles reflecting the share consolidation, failed to achieve two-thirds special resolution approval. The filing is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation.
